records.title: SteerSeg: Attention Steering for Reasoning Video Segmentation
records.reason: Attention steering is for video reasoning segmentation and does not establish an LLM inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: LATERN: Test-Time Context-Aware Explainable Video Anomaly Detection
records.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1, method, experiments/ablations: LATERN uses gated historical summaries and recursive event-window aggregation for VLM video anomaly detection; InternVL2-8B UCF-Crime AUC is reported as 87.63 vs 86.42 baseline, and ungated summaries degrade results. The tested contribution is temporal context/reasoning quality, not measured inference-cost reduction or compression; memory/token overhead is not shown. Weak VLM context-management adjacency only.

records.title: Deep Mixture of Experts Network for Resource Optimization in Aerial–Terrestrial CF-mMIMO Systems Under URLLC
records.reason: MoE resource allocation is for URLLC wireless communications; it is not an LLM inference method.

records.title: Locale-Conditioned Few-Shot Prompting Mitigates Demonstration Regurgitation in On-Device PII Substitution with Small Language Models
records.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1 and 4: a fully on-device PII substitution pipeline combines a 1.5B MoE classifier, 1-bit 1.7B SLM, and rule-based substitutions; on x86-64 CPU with 31 GB RAM, hybrid mode reports 41.2 s average latency versus 1.6–1.7 s for non-generative alternatives. Locale-conditioned rotating examples address demonstration regurgitation. The target is privacy substitution and latency is high; no general LLM efficiency improvement is claimed. Weak on-device SLM deployment adjacency only.
